name: Drinking In Moderation
overview: Scripture acknowledges the provision of wine as part of God's good creation and invites believers to enjoy it with a joyful heart, as seen in Psalms 104:14 and Ecclesiastes 9:7. However, the Bible also warns against the dangers of excessive drinking, highlighting that wine can deceive and lead to sorrow, contention, and harm (Proverbs 20:1; Proverbs 23:29). Christians are called to exercise wisdom and self-control, avoiding anything that might cause a brother to stumble or be weakened in faith (Romans 14:21). Thus, drinking in moderation honors God’s gifts while safeguarding spiritual and communal well-being.
